question: In the context of the passage, select the most appropriate option to fill in blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is '**no**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**no longer**" is a commonly used idiomatic expression that means "**not anymore**."
 
• The passage is indicating that sustainability has evolved from just being a buzzword to becoming a necessity.
 
• "**No**" correctly fits in this context to convey the intended meaning.
 
• Other options ("**any**", "**never**", "**not**") do not fit the idiomatic expression "**no longer**."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Sustainability is no__ longer just a buzzword. It ****___(2)___** **a necessity and the primary agenda of the world today. Like many other countries, India too is witnessing a growth of ****___(3)___*** *green economy. It ****___(4)___*** *estimated that India’s renewable energy target will create more than 3.4 million new job opportunities ****___(5)___*** *2030. In fact, a recent survey stated that a Sustainability Manager is going to be one of the top 10 jobs this decade.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **any**: "**Any**" does not grammatically fit with "longer" in the context of the passage.
 
• **never**: "**Never**" implies that it was not a buzzword at any time, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **not**: "**Not**" alone does not fit correctly with "longer" in this context, as it does not form the correct idiomatic expression.
